posts.title: The Old Musical Express
posts.description: New Musical Express on the 1983 reissue of Charlie Gillett 's 1971 book The Sound of the City. Reviewer Paul Du Noyer notes that " interest in old music has never been higher ", with NME 's own series of cassette compilations of vintage soul, jazz, reggae, etc, given as proof. He says the timely reissue of Gillett's classic tome can nourish the evident appetite for history out there. 1983 figures
